page-error-description: We could not load this page. Try again, or head back home.
jelly-ambient-description: Haze drifts and swirls inside every surface, calm behind text and livelier at the rim. It slows to an idle floor when you stop, and stops completely when the tab is hidden or nothing hazy is on screen.
jelly-arcs-blocked: No arc: arcs are off in your settings, or the flash limit was reached.
jelly-arcs-description: Close surfaces now and then throw an arc across the gap, more often the nearer they are. Every click discharges one to three arcs to the nearest neighbours. A site-wide limit keeps flashes to three a second.
jelly-arcs-still-note: Jelly motion is Still, so arcs stay off for now.
jelly-card-default-body: Repeated content: a rim within budget and a drifting haze.
jelly-card-interactive-body: Hover to lean it, press to squash it.
jelly-card-pane-body: A singular panel with an ambient haze slot.
jelly-footer: Internal design-lab reference. The contract is
jelly-gallery-description: The shared primitives every page composes from, so reviewers can check that each one carries the material and the soft body.
jelly-globe-description: Open the menu: the globe keeps its own jelly coat and a dough body. Press it and material banks up around your finger, drag kneads it, and it eases back over a couple of seconds.
jelly-intro: Every surface is a slab of hazy, translucent jelly. Haze drifts inside it, its rim refracts and catches the light, it squashes when you press it, and nearby surfaces spark. Text and layout never move.
jelly-motion-description: These are your real Appearance settings, so a change here applies across the site. Still pauses all ambient motion and turns arcs off; pressing still works.
jelly-role-chrome-note: Persistent chrome: sticky headers, the dock. Refracts the page under it.
jelly-role-fill-note: Repeated content: cards, rows, tiles. A rim within budget and a soft body.
jelly-role-inset-note: Inputs and tab tracks. A flush pool of jelly that arcs never touch.
jelly-role-overlay-note: Floating UI: dialogs, menus, popovers. The quietest, densest interior.
jelly-role-pane-note: Singular panels: heroes, composers, settings. A drifting haze slot.
jelly-roles-description: Each class names an elevation role, not a look. The jelly material renders every role; the role decides how loud it may be and what it costs.
jelly-squash-description: Hover plumps and leans a card toward the cursor, a press squashes it toward your finger, and release wobbles it back. A firm release nudges close neighbours by a pixel or two. Edges never travel more than 4px and layout never changes.
